Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting county assessors from publicizing real property owners' personal information.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting county assessors from publicizingreal property owners' personal information; adding a new section tochapter 36.21 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature to limitthe amount of information that is made public in property assessmentsin order to protect property owners from being the victims of crime.Currently, property assessment information has included photographsthat have contained pictures of property owners' children, vehicleswith license plate numbers, and other related personal information. Inorder to prevent property owners from being potential victims of crime,this type of information must not be made public.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: When assessing the value of real property, the county assessor oragents of the assessor shall not publicize any personal informationrelated to the property owner that is not in relation to the assessment p. 1 SB 5515of the property. Personal information includes, but is not limited to,the following: (1) Pictures of children, automobiles, pets, alarm systems, orfloor plans; and (2) Information contained in print or picture that may assist aperson in committing a crime.
